description: Installs the Modal CLI and Modal's official skill to help coding agents use its latest features. Modal is a platform for running AI workloads in the cloud with minimal configuration; key use cases include AI model training and inference, high-performance batch jobs, and sandboxed code execution. Modal offers official SDKs in Python, Go, and JavaScript/TypeScript, along with a CLI for interacting with the platform.

capabilities: Run untrusted code in Modal Sandboxes
defaultPrompt: Create a Modal app that runs a Python function on a GPU
Deploy this script as a scheduled Modal job
Run this untrusted code inside a Modal Sandbox
